title: Jude and the Typewriter
author: Vesper Amberdale
blurb: Elodie Sterling, a typeface cutter's daughter in a print shop on the eve of a revolution, believes history happens to other people, elsewhere. Then the bridge — the only road out — closes for the season — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must finish the work while the workshop still stands, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
